title: Shortcut Confirm
summary: Makes a destructive keyboard shortcut need a deliberate second press, so a slipped finger only shows a prompt.
description: Two-press guard for destructive shortcuts: the first press shows "Press ⌘⌫ again to delete 3 items", and only a separate second press within the window confirms. Held keys, extra modifiers, stray keys in between and keystrokes in text fields don't count.
catches: A first press, which only arms and explains
Key auto-repeat from holding the shortcut
Any other key pressed between the two presses
Shortcuts typed inside inputs, unless allowInInputs
limits: Guards the keyboard path only; menu or button paths need their own confirm
Letters also match by physical key, so a layout remap could still trigger it
a11y: Armed and done prompts render in a polite live region
Shortcut shown as ⌘ on Apple platforms and Ctrl elsewhere
